title: riskell registry listing
description: One file per listing in listings/<id>.json. A listing is metadata that points at an author's repository at one pinned commit; the code stays in the author's repository under the author's license. An update is a new pull request.

id.description: Equal to the id in the repository's riskell.json, and to the file name.

kind.description: Equal to the manifest's kind (an atom listing may also be a reading).

repo.description: The git repository (https). It stays the author's.

path.description: A folder inside the repository, for a repository that holds several. Only for listings marked bundled: an installable extension has its riskell.json at the repository root.

rev.description: The full commit the listing is pinned to. What people install is this commit, so an author cannot change it silently.

version.description: Equal to the manifest's version at that commit; the repository should carry a tag v<version> on it.

atoms.description: The atom ids it adds (placed as ext:<id>); equal to the manifest's atoms.

preview.description: A path inside the repository to a PNG.

bundled.description: True for what ships inside riskell itself: it is installed already, and `risk ext add` says so.
